balance_sheet_equation.formula: Total Assets == Total Liabilities + Stockholders Equity
balance_sheet_equation.description: Fundamental accounting identity: Total Assets must equal Total Liabilities plus Stockholders Equity within allowable rounding margin.

net_profit_margin.description: Net profit margin sanity check: flags extreme margins or unexpected loss ratios.

cash_liquidity_ratio.formula: Cash and Cash Equivalents / Total Assets * 100
cash_liquidity_ratio.description: Cash and cash equivalents cannot exceed total assets.

unit_scale_consistency.description: Validates that balance sheet items and income statement metrics share identical scaling (e.g. In Thousands vs In Millions).
